data.title: 圣园未花 · 宵夜草莓卷的小秘密
data.description: 寝室台灯调到最柔和的一档，未花穿着象牙白蕾丝吊带睡裙盘腿坐在松软大床上，面前小托盘里偷藏着一盘切成两半的草莓瑞士卷。她用银叉叉起带草莓的一块凑过来，俏皮地眨眨眼说这是今晚两个人的秘密加餐。
data.location: 柔暖台灯下的纯白蕾丝寝室大床
data.action: 盘腿坐于大床上举起叉着草莓瑞士卷的银叉，俏皮喂食
data.lighting: 暖白床头灯照亮甜点与象牙白真丝柔光
data.camera: 平视中近景，拉近互动距离感
data.mood: 甜美、调皮、充满亲密分享欲
promptTokens: holding fork with strawberry roll cake
data.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged on her plush white bed under warm lamplight, Mika holds out a forkful of strawberry roll cake from a small bedside plate. Her ivory silk nightgown with slender straps and scalloped lace border looks soft and effortless as she smiles playfully.
data.animaCaption: Sitting on her lamplit bed, she playfully offers a forkful of strawberry roll cake toward the viewer.
data.nsfwProse: The ivory silk nightgown with its delicate chest bow and floral lace trim clings lightly as she leans forward.
